# Introduction

We had a guest speaker, Travis Miller, who talked about careers in market research and insights. After that, we went over assignments and what we need to improve from our presentations.

# Guest Speaker: Travis Miller

- Travis is the Senior Vice President of Sales and Client Development at PureSpectrum.
- He also serves as the volunteer president of the Insights Association West Chapter.
- He has nearly 20 years of experience in market research and insights.
- He started gaining experience through a research project while attending CSU Channel Islands.

## Market Research and Insights Career Paths

- Market research and insights have many different career opportunities.
- Technology has changed the types of jobs available and will continue to change the industry.
- Getting started involves a lot of on-the-job learning.
- Classes in statistics, business, analytics, writing, and consumer behavior can help prepare us.
- Outside of class, it helps to follow current events, technology, and consumer trends.
- The main idea is to find a problem, collect data, and use it to provide answers.
